answer: The sparrow schedule is applied in pulse and mesa publishes each instalment. A payout is split so that 53% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2443 identities would post 2554 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
